t: An open controller board that drives 3D printers, laser cutters, and small CNC machines.
steps: Buy the WiFi or Ethernet version from Filastruder or Ooznest.
Use the Duet3D online config tool to describe your machine and download the files.
Copy the files onto the microSD card for the board.
Wire the power supply, motors, heaters, fans, and temperature sensors with the power off.
Connect the board to your computer over USB and check that it starts.
Join it to your WiFi or plug in a network cable.
Open the web interface in a browser and home each axis.
Heat the hot end and run a small test print.
meta: Open Board. From $150. A few stores.
